subject: Request: one-time billing offset for delayed multi-model routing (ACME)
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time billing offset for delayed multi-model routing

Hi Soojin,

Hope you're well. Quick note: our engineering team finished integration testing last week and hit a blocker because the multi-model routing feature you demoed in December isn't in the hosted API yet. Our launch is delayed and we expect ~3 weeks slippage. This has direct impact on our go-live and marketing spend.

Given the timeline shift (and the fact we committed to a Q2 launch), we'd like to request a one-time billing offset to compensate for the delay while we finish work. Specifically, can Redwood provide a partial offset for March and April invoices (we're proposing a 30% offset for those two months)?

I've attached the integration logs and the latest SOW showing milestone dates. We can be flexible on mechanics.

Thanks,

Lina Park
Director, Product
ACME Corp
Attachments: ACME_integration_logs_20260303.zip, SOW_ACME_v2.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time billing offset for delayed multi-model routing

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and for sending the logs.

I'm sorry the missing routing capability blocked your launch; I understand the downstream impact. I'm looping in our sales and finance leads to review a one-time billing offset and confirm next steps. We'll aim to respond with an approval and implementation plan by EOD 2026-03-05.

Vivek / Finance – quick context:
- ACME (RDW-7892) expected multi-model routing in hosted API; feature is on our roadmap with a March->April slip
- Customer asks for a 30% offset for March+April invoices while they delay go-live
- Attachments: logs + SOW

Request: can you weigh in on approval band (percent, cap) and any commercial conditions (SOW amendment, term commit)?

Thanks,

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time billing offset for delayed multi-model routing

Thanks for flagging, Soojin.

High-level I approve making an accommodation to preserve the relationship, but we should limit downside and attach commercial guardrails.

Proposed company position:
- Approve a 25% billing offset for March and April invoices
- Cap total offset at $45,000
- Condition: customer signs amended SOW (amendment to confirm revised delivery and commitment to 12-month minimum term) and confirms new launch window within 30 days
- Accounting/recognition: finance to confirm mechanics (credit memo vs. invoice adjustment)

Lauren: can finance confirm the cap and booking treatment? If OK, Soojin please send customer a short amendment + DocuSign link and we'll execute.

Vivek
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time billing offset for delayed multi-model routing

Agree to the approach with clarifications.

Finance notes:
- Approve up to $45,000 total offset as a credit memo against March/April invoices
- Require amended SOW (DocuSign) that references the offset and revised milestones
- Need a GL code for the credit; Soojin please include 'PROMO-2026' in your ticket
- We will apply credits in the next billing cycle after DocuSign executes; timing ~ 30 days

I'll open FIN-312 to track. Once signed, we can issue the credit memo and confirm with ACME's AR (acme-billing@acme.com).

-Lauren
Director, Finance Operations
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: partial billing offset and next steps

Hi Lina — thanks for your patience.

We can approve a one-time partial billing offset per the following terms:

- 25% offset on March and April invoices
- Total offset capped at $45,000
- Condition: ACME signs the attached amended SOW (DocuSign link below) which updates delivery milestones and confirms a 12-month minimum term commitment
- Once DocuSign is executed, Redwood Finance will issue a credit memo applied to the next billing cycle (~30 days)

DocuSign: https://docu.sign/acme-amend
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/22345
Internal ticket: FIN-312

Attachments included in this thread for reference: SOW_ACME_v2.pdf, amended_sow_draft.docx

Please let me know if the terms are acceptable and we'll route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
